fields.body_md:
## About this programme

Thinking of an MSc in computer science at Newcastle? Here is what it costs, who can get in and when to apply.

The Newcastle MSc Computer Science is a **conversion course**. That means it is for graduates whose first degree is **not** in computer science. It runs for 12 months full-time on campus in Newcastle, starting in September 2027.

**The most important fact for you:** you need a 2:2 or equivalent in a subject that is not computer science. Graduates in computing subjects should apply for Newcastle's Advanced Computer Science MSc instead.

Newcastle says 93% of graduates are in work or further study 15 months after graduating (Graduate Outcomes Survey 2018/19 to 2023/24).

For the wider university, see our [Newcastle University page](/study-abroad/universities/newcastle-university).

## Can you get in?

**Degree.** You need a bachelor's degree with a **2:2 honours** or equivalent in any subject except those related to computer science. Newcastle says it will look at lower or non-standard qualifications case by case if you have relevant experience.

**Indian marks.** Newcastle's India table lists a 2:2 as **58%** to **63%** (CGPA **5.8** to **6.3** out of 10) and a 2:1 as **60%** to **65%** (CGPA **6.0** to **6.5**). The page splits these into three bands called Section 1, 2 and 3 and does not explain which band your university falls in. Ask the admissions team before you apply. A 2:2 and a 2:1 are UK honours grades.

**GRE.** The course page does not mention GRE. GRE is a US-style graduate admissions test.

**English.** IELTS is an English language test. You need **IELTS 6.5** overall with at least **5.5** in every part.

**ATAS.** ATAS (Academic Technology Approval Scheme) is a UK security clearance that some science and technology courses need before you get a visa. Newcastle's course page does not say whether this course needs it. Its deposit rules only mention ATAS in general. Ask the admissions team when you get your offer. If it is needed, an ATAS application takes at least **30 working days**.

## What it costs

Tuition for international students is **£33,400** per year for 2027 entry. The course lasts 12 months.

Newcastle is outside London, so the outside-London visa rule applies. This is the worked first-year total.

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition for international students, 2027 entry | £33,400 |
| Living money you must show for your visa: £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Student visa application fee, from outside the UK | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge for a visa of just over a year | £1,164 |
| **Total** | **£45,661** |

The sum is £33,400 + £10,539 + £558 + £1,164 = £45,661. Travel and housing are not included.

**Living money is money you show, not a fee.** The visa rule is **£1,171** for each month of your course outside London, up to **9 months**. You must hold this money for **28 days** in a row. The 28-day period must end within **31 days** of the date you apply. You do not pay it to the university.

**Health surcharge.** The Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) is a charge for using the NHS while you are in the UK. It is set by the length of your visa, not your course. For a course of 12 months or longer, the visa adds up to **1 month** before and **4 months** after the course. That makes a visa of more than a year but under 18 months. You then pay the yearly **£776** plus half of it, **£388**, so **£1,164**.

**Deposit.** Indian students pay a **£3,000** deposit, or submit an official letter of sponsorship, by **27 August 2027**. If the course needs ATAS, the date is **13 August 2027**. The deposit is non-refundable and is deducted from tuition when you register. You need a CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) for your visa. This is the electronic letter your university issues.

For the visa steps, read the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To plan the whole budget, use the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Funding

Newcastle lists two automatic awards that could apply to Indian students. The course pages do not confirm that this course is eligible for the India award.

- **India Future Leaders Scholarship:** **£10,000** off tuition. You must be domiciled in India, hold an offer for an eligible master's for 2027/28, and pay your deposit in full by **2 August 2027**. It is automatic as part of your application. Newcastle keeps a list of courses that are not eligible in a PDF, so check this course against it. See the [scholarship page](https://www.ncl.ac.uk/postgraduate/fees-funding/search-funding/?code=nuifls27).
- **Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarship:** **£8,000** off tuition. It is also automatic once you apply. You must accept your offer and pay your deposit in full by **2 August 2027**.
- **Vice-Chancellor's Excellence Scholarship:** up to **50%** off tuition, with a deadline of **8 June 2027**.

See all awards on the [global scholarships page](https://www.ncl.ac.uk/study/global-scholarships/). The totals above do not subtract any award, because the page does not say whether the India and Vice-Chancellor awards can be held together.

## Deadlines and intakes

Newcastle says there is **no application closing date** for this course. It suggests international students apply at least **two months** before the course starts, so you have time to arrange your visa. Funding deadlines may be earlier than the course deadline: the deposit date for the automatic awards is **2 August 2027**, and the Excellence Scholarship closes on **8 June 2027**. The course starts in September only, so a January start is not confirmed.

## How to apply

1. **Check the entry rules.** You need a 2:2 or equivalent in a non-computer-science subject.
2. **Apply online.** Start from the [course page](https://www.ncl.ac.uk/postgraduate/degrees/5055f/). Apply at least two months before September 2027.
3. **Accept your offer and pay the deposit.** Pay **£3,000** or send a sponsorship letter by **27 August 2027**. Pay by **2 August 2027** to be considered for the automatic awards.
4. **Check ATAS.** Ask the admissions team if the course needs an ATAS certificate.
5. **Apply for your visa.** You need your CAS, a current passport, proof of funds and your tuberculosis (TB) test result. India is on the UK's TB test list. The test must be at a clinic approved by the Home Office. Read the [TB test page](https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa/countries-where-you-need-a-tb-test-to-enter-the-uk) and the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide).

## After the programme

- **Work in the UK after your course.** The Graduate Route lets you stay and work in the UK after your studies. The visa lasts **2 years** if you apply on or before **31 December 2026**, and **18 months** if you apply on or after **1 January 2027**. A September 2027 student applies in 2028, so expect 18 months. The application fee is **£937**.


## Who it suits

**This programme is a strong choice if:**

- your degree is in another subject and you want to move into computing
- your marks are around 58% or more in an Indian degree
- you want a one-year course with no closing date

**Think carefully if:**

- you already have a computer science degree, because Newcastle points you to Advanced Computer Science
- you need a January start, because only September is shown
- you rely on the India award, because it is not confirmed that this course is eligible

faq_json.q: How much does the Newcastle MSc Computer Science cost for Indian students?
faq_json.a: Tuition is £33,400 per year for 2027 entry. With visa living money, the visa fee and the health surcharge, the first year comes to £45,661 before any scholarship.

faq_json.q: What percentage do Indian students need for Newcastle MSc Computer Science?
faq_json.a: Newcastle's India table lists a 2:2 as 58% to 63%, depending on a band it calls Section 1 to 3. The page does not explain the bands, so ask the admissions team.

faq_json.q: Does Newcastle need GRE for MSc Computer Science?
faq_json.a: The course page does not mention GRE. It asks for IELTS 6.5 overall with at least 5.5 in each part.

faq_json.q: What is the deadline for Newcastle MSc Computer Science 2027?
faq_json.a: There is no closing date. Newcastle suggests applying at least two months before the course starts. Pay your deposit by 2 August 2027 for the automatic awards.

faq_json.q: Is there a scholarship for Indian students at Newcastle?
faq_json.a: Yes. The India Future Leaders Scholarship gives £10,000 automatically to eligible students. The course pages do not confirm that this course is eligible, so check the list of excluded courses.
